descriptionHtml:
What you'll do

Triage alerts from the Splunk SIEM, escalate genuine incidents to L3 responders, and write runbooks for recurring alert classes. This is a hybrid role: 3 days on-site in Hyderabad, 2 days remote.

  • Monitor and investigate alerts in Splunk ES and CrowdStrike Falcon
  • Document findings in Jira and ServiceNow tickets
  • Perform log analysis across AWS CloudTrail and Okta sign-in logs

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of SOC experience with a SIEM such as Splunk, QRadar or Microsoft Sentinel
  • Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS and firewall fundamentals
  • Scripting ability in Python or PowerShell

What we offer

  • Health coverage and term life insurance
  • 18 days PTO plus public holidays

Salary: $95,000-$120,000 per year depending on experience.
title: SOC Analyst L2
